pages.text: Right-click glass or a pane to recover the same block. Both cutters work on vanilla and modded blocks tagged as glass or glass panes. Protected blocks still follow normal break permissions.

pages.title: Choose a Cutter
pages.text: The ordinary cutter loses one durability and has a half-second cooldown. The Reinforced Glass Cutter has no cooldown or wear when cutting placed glass.$(br2)Both can make $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:materials/ender_parts)Ender Shards$(/l) in a crafting grid.
